settingsSectionDesc: Configure n8n webhooks via [Tools] -> [joplin2n8n Change Settings] menu.
settingsButtonDesc: Click to manage your n8n webhooks.
openManagerOptionDesc: [Manage] Check this and apply to open the webhook manager dialog. (You can also open it via Tools -> Joplin2n8n Settings)
showInContextMenuLabel: [UI] Show in Note List Context Menu
showInContextMenuDesc: When unchecked, the send action will be hidden from the right-click context menu in the note list. Takes effect after restarting Joplin.
showInNoteToolbarLabel: [UI] Show in note toolbar (paper plane icon)
showInNoteToolbarDesc: When unchecked, the paper plane toolbar button in the top-right of the note editor will be hidden. Takes effect after restarting Joplin.
showInNoteToolbarDescMobile: If unchecked, the send action will be hidden from the top-right ··· menu. Requires restart.
showInEditorToolbarLabel: [UI] Show integrated send button in Editor Top Toolbar
showInEditorToolbarDesc: If unchecked, the airplane icon in the editor top toolbar will be hidden. Clicking it allows selecting from a webhook list.
showInEditorToolbarLabelMobile: [UI] Show integrated send button in Editor Bottom Toolbar
showInEditorToolbarDescMobile: If unchecked, the airplane icon in the editor bottom toolbar will be hidden. Clicking it allows selecting from a webhook list.
showInToolsMenuDesc: When unchecked, send actions are hidden from the Tools menu. (The settings dialog entry is always shown.) Takes effect after restarting Joplin.
copyNoteBeforeSendLabel: [Action] Copy note to clipboard before sending
copyNoteBeforeSendDesc: Automatically copy the original note content to the clipboard before sending it to the webhook.
noWebhooksConfigured: No webhooks configured. Please add one in [Tools] -> [joplin2n8n Change Settings].
fileInsertedAtCursor: %s has been inserted at the cursor position.
fileInsertedAtEnd: %s has been inserted at the end of the note.
restartRequiredToApplyUIChanges: Webhook settings have been changed. Please restart Joplin to fully apply the changes to the toolbar and context menu.
errorNoteMismatch: The currently active note is different from the note that sent the request. To replace its body, the original note must be open in the editor.
errorMobileFileUnsupported: Mobile devices do not support direct file downloads and resource creation.
errorMobileReplaceUnsupported: Replacing selected text on mobile is currently not supported via API. Please copy to clipboard and paste manually.
